text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens (dark green curly and flat leaves with some purple-red stems and veins), lightly moistened, piled loosely in the upper-left half of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate footprint, about 4-5 cm tall at the mound | 85
ITEM 2 | Cooked grain mixture (pale tan and brown grains with flecks of green and small pieces of golden-yellow and white bits), slightly clumped, matte surface, covering roughly 20% of the plate on the right-center, about 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown cubes of firm, pan-seared or roasted material (about 1.5-2 cm pieces) with browned edges and a dry, slightly crisp surface, sitting in the grain mixture on the lower-right | 40
ITEM 4 | Pieces of pale, lightly browned, firm protein (about 2 cm chunks) with irregular edges and a slightly seared surface, at the bottom-right edge of the grain mixture | 25
ITEM 5 | Bright green broccoli-like florets (about 1-2 cm), slightly wilted, glossy, scattered among the grain mixture on the right side | 20
ITEM 6 | Cucumber slices (pale green skin, lighter pale flesh with small seeds), two or three rounds about 3 cm across and 0.5 cm thick, with moist surface, at the lower-left edge of the greens | 15
ITEM 7 | Crumbled white cheese (small white crumbles, about 0.3-0.5 cm, dry and matte), scattered over the greens and cucumber on the left | 8
ITEM 8 | Dark dried fruit or raisin-like pieces (wrinkled, dark purple-brown, about 0.5 cm), scattered among the greens in the center-left | 5
ITEM 9 | Small pale diced pieces (about 0.5 cm, tan/cream, slightly translucent) mixed with the grain, possibly onion-like shreds, near the top of the grain mixture | 5
